title: AndroidWorld Screen, Selection, Confirmation — proposed frozen template split
notes: Screen is a five-task execution gate. Selection adds 20 new templates. Confirmation is the remaining 91 templates.
Artemis outcomes and seconds are historical observations at one instance per template. They are not proposed DGM scores or predicted runtimes.
All 25 information-retrieval templates scored zero in the supplied Artemis run; audit answer/evaluator integration before using their scores to rank candidates.
The two VLC templates remain in Confirmation because the supplied Artemis run failed before task execution due to a missing app database. Preflight VLC before Confirmation.
Confirmation templates are held out from DGM optimization, although the Artemis full-suite baseline was inspected to construct this partition.
Freeze task parameters and evaluation seeds separately. Use paired parent/child instances in Selection and fresh seeds for Confirmation.
